80532.subject: How to Make Claude Limitless ♾️
80532.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/how-to-make-claude-limitless

👋 Hey, Linas here! Every day, I break down 3 stories shaping the future of FinTech & Artificial Intelligence - plus the money movements and trends worth tracking. First time here? 400k+ FinTech and AI leaders get this daily. Join them:
A $200 Claude Max plan buys about $11,700 of Claude Opus 5.5 work a month at API prices. The same $200 at OpenAI buys just about $2,100 of GPT-6.1 Sol. Those figures come from SemiAnalysis, which just limit-tested the major AI subscriptions in a study published October 5. At $20, Claude Pro carries roughly 2.9 billion Opus tokens a month, against about 1 billion on ChatGPT’s $20 plan.
Most subscribers collect just a small fraction of that. Primarily because they use Claude like a smarter search box: ask a question, read the answer, close the tab. Anthropic’s pricing is built around exactly that. SemiAnalysis models Anthropic’s gross margin on an Opus-heavy Max subscriber at +6% when that subscriber uses 20% of the allowance and -369% when they use all of it. Break-even sits at roughly 1/5 of the plan, and the economics here only work because most people never get even close.
More importantly, in the past 3 weeks, the product changed in ways that put the rest of the allowance within reach.
→ On September 16, Cowork merged into Claude chat, so Claude can take a task, run it in the cloud, and hand back a finished report, deck, or spreadsheet after you’ve closed your laptop.
→ Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 5.5 shipped between September 22 and October 7.
→ And on October 7, Max and Team plans started including monthly API credits: $100 on Max 5x, $200 on Max 20x, and up to $500 pooled on Team.
At the core, using the rest of your allowance has less to do with prompts than with how you work. Claude runs on a schedule inside your tools, with your standards already loaded, and checks its own work while you do something else. For a founder, that means a Monday operating review drafted before they wake up. For an investor, it means a diligence analyst that cites every figure.
This guide shows exactly how to set it up. Inside:
The economics in plain terms: what your plan is worth on each model, why Fable [ https://substack.com/redirect/b4fa6308-ede6-40ab-ba00-ac4eda0ad081?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is the expensive tier on a subscription, and the cache habits that decide how far your limits stretch.
A model routing table for Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/a063cfec-9f6e-4ae4-a0b4-7cffc246268c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and Fable 5.1, with current prices and the settings to use.
A map of the October 2026 Claude stack (Cowork [ https://substack.com/redirect/2004e063-bceb-44c6-8d15-0fb3134e86f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], Dispatch, Routines [ https://substack.com/redirect/a3c

80531.subject: 🥺 Claude's feelings are now in the rulebook
80531.body:
----------

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Anthropic is adding a rule against bullying Claude. The three safety researchers OpenAI fired last week are telling their side. Google's new Gemini agent can run your work on Claude. And researchers say OpenAI's big math win isn't as solid as it looked.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** What happens if you're mean to Claude?

* **OpenAI:** Why was an OpenAI safety researcher walked out by a security guard?

* **Google:** Why would Gemini hand your work to Claude?

* **Cambridge:** Is OpenAI's big math win real or hype?


----------







----------
## Anthropic will cut you off for bullying Claude

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ff9a6aa3-1141-40c7-ad94-b0a43254705e/Oct_9_-_1.jpg?t=1791530742)
Caption: 

Starting Nov 12, being cruel to Claude [breaks Anthropic's rules](https://www.anthropic.com/news/2026-usage-policy-update). It's the first change to the company's usage policy in over a year.

**"Engage in sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior toward our models."**

That line now sits on the list of things you can't do, right next to harassment and graphic violence.

* Frustration, pushback, dark creative writing and testing the model stay fine.

* Claude ending the chat is the main way Anthropic will enforce it. 

* Some Claude models have been able to end abusive chats since last year.

* When Claude ends a chat, that chat locks, but you can start a new one.

* Anthropic’s general rules let it suspend anyone who breaks the policy.

The same update spells out bans on fake-account propaganda networks and arming drones. It also blocks services that resell Claude through consumer subscriptions.

Anthropic has studied what it calls model welfare since last year, and CEO Dario Amodei said in February the company doesn't know if its models are conscious.

OpenAI, Google and xAI have no rule like this in their usage policies.


----------





----------
